title: Sporty Johnson and the Club Desire
summary: Williams knew Sporty Johnson; Club Desire booked big acts and hired local small players like him.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Yeah, they had some friends. Did you know Sporty Johnson?
He was an emcee I guess.
I've been with Sporter John for years.
There used to be a lot of talent there. I never went to the Club Desire, what was that like?
Oh, the Club Desire was something big and beautiful. They brought in big things there. Club Desire was beautiful.

It was beautiful. They brought all big attractions in Club Desire. You remember when the Fat Davin new first mate B? He was strong, going big. Well, they kept him at Club Desire. Rod Brown, that was a big man. Remember that big number that stands out today? What's that? That big number is Good Rockin' Tonight.

And Good Rockin' At Midnight, all that. So, the boy was there. Club Desire booked all the bars. Louis Jordan, all of them at Club Desire. Joe Turner. Ivory Joe Hunter. Did you work there? I worked there many times. I didn't have with no damn band, but I worked there. Worked different little things. Big bands wouldn't come in. They used to hire all the local things, small things like me. Uh-huh. They hired them.
